positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, implemented, and launched an internal quoting solution actively used by over 3000 technical sales representatives

Expanded the team's usage of React and Typescript through developer training and reusable component development

Developed and supported the full stack for web applications in the Law, Finance, and Pricing domain using Java, Spring, Tomcat, React, Angular, Typescript, and Oracle SQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Co-led six student team to develop and design web applications using Ruby on Rails, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, MySQL, and React

Deployed and managed applications and infrastructure to AWS using Elastic Beanstalk, Lambda, and S3

Worked closely with stakeholders in the finance department to accelerate and improve visibility into college's hiring

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Designed and developed a web application to improve company-wide communication for systems security and risk analysis

Optimized web service in Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL for querying and updating tree structure data

Trailblazed the team's usage of internal cloud service by implementing and documenting deployment procedures for Rails applications

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Improved interactivity of gamified architecture modeling solutions by designing and implementing pedestrian and traffic modeling, adding satellite imagery, and new overlays for relevant city data

Automated geospatial mappings in Unity by creating scripts to map ESRI Shapefile data, satellite imagery, and geospatial coordinates to locations and models inside game scene

Designed and optimized Restful service for storing and pulling geospatial data

projects.title: Disaster IQ
projects.description: Prototyped an automated platform for collecting, analyzing, and spreading critical information during disaster events
